author: dragon_trappers_lodge
title: Hiring Concept Artist for 3D Printable Miniatures
content: WE'RE HIRING: CONCEPT ARTIST! The position will entail creating 2d concept art for 3d printable fantasy miniatures. Concepts will need to be refined line art drawings. No rendering, color, or value work required. Typically no turnarounds required, occasional weapon or prop details may be needed. Often there will be multiple poses which will require loose sketches. We pay $100/concept with more complex detailed creatures granting more pay on a case by case basis. If you enjoy designing characters and monsters but don't like spending weeks on the same design then this is for you. You will be able to work on many designs and someone who works quick will thrive in this role. The quicker you work the more we can send you. Creativity is extremely valuable and there is lots of room for creative freedom. People who don't work quickly, or are unable to take direction and revisions won't do well in this position. The following skill sets are required: in depth understanding of human anatomy, in depth understanding of creature and animal anatomy, great drawing and sketching skills, understanding of dynamic posing. All applications must be submitted through our official BambooHR hiring page, linked in our bio.

author: young.onion
title: Hiring Kawaii Artists for Stationery Collection
content: WE ARE HIRING KAWAII ARTISTS! Calling all creators of all things cute, pastel, and absolutely adorable! We are on the lookout for talented artists to bring their kawaii magic to our upcoming stationery collection! If you love drawing chubby characters, happy little stationery, and sweet pastel doodles, we want to see your work! From journals and stickers to washi tapes and pens, let’s make something magical together. How to apply: 1. Make sure you're following us [@young.onion]! 2. Drop a comment below with your favorite emoji and tag an artist friend who needs to see this! 3. Send us a DM with a link to your portfolio or fill out the application form in our bio! You can also mail us info@youngonion.in Can't wait to see your cute art!

author: smorgasburg
title: Looking for Local Illustrator for 2027 NYC Flyer
content: Smorgasburg, through your eyes. Calling all local artists! We’re looking for a local illustrator or designer to create our 2027 NYC vendor application flyer! This is a paid commission, with full artist credit and the potential for many future collaborations. We want to see something different from our past flyers. Something unmistakably New York that captures the messy, human experience of eating here: hands making food, friends sharing a bite, cultures meeting across a counter. Your style, your perspective. Submit your portfolio or Instagram through the link in bio by November 10. A sketch is optional, but including one helps us understand your vision and may speed up our review—rough ideas are welcome. The final flyer, featuring the selected artist’s work, will be posted on November 20.

author: mostafa_gawad
title: Hiring Vector Background Artists for Animated Series

Attention to detail and good artistic skills. Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance). Send your CV and Portfolio to: jobs@jumpanimation.com or gawad26@gmail.com You can also message us directly through Facebook!

author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Writers and More
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE We’re looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects. These positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more. These positions are paid but we’re open to collaboration / internships. If you meet the requirements listed, then please send a PROFESSIONAL email to: whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with the following information: Name, general location, Position applying for, Resume/Portfolio with previous & current experience & examples, Rate per panel & for 60 panels (+/-), Rates for services/etc. (be open to negotiations if necessary), Turnaround Time for 60 panels/other work, Programs / Software used (Clip Studio Paint, etc), Preferred Payment Method (However, PayPal is what we will use), Other notable experience / specializations. NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE. ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE IN THE PROCESS OR FINAL DELIVERABLES.
